name: Signature Request
description: Send an agreement that is already final out for signature. Only for documents Legal approved or unmodified Fontara templates.

fields.label: Is this document approved for signature?
fields.description: Anything else needs a review first.

fields.text: This document needs Legal review first. Submit a Third-Party Paper Review (their draft) or the matching agreement request (our template) instead.

fields.label: Counterparty signer
fields.description: Name and title of the person who signs for them.

fields.label: Fontara contracting entity
fields.description: The Fontara company that signs. US business: Fontara, Inc. UK: Fontara UK Ltd. EU: Fontara Europe Ltd.

fields.label: Total contract value (TCV)
fields.description: All years, excluding tax. Sets who may sign under the signing-authority policy.

fields.label: Fontara signatory, and anything the signers should know
fields.description: Name and title of the Fontara signatory under the signing-authority policy, then any signing instructions.

fields.label: Business owner
fields.description: The person accountable for this agreement after it is signed.

fields.label: Urgency
fields.description: Standard is five business days. Urgent needs a VP's approval: name them in the reason. Urgency changes how fast Legal Operations (Maya Patel) works the request, not who approves the deal, which follows Fontara's escalation matrix.

fields.label: Why is this urgent?
fields.description: The business deadline or risk, and the VP who approved the urgency.

fields.label: Needed by
fields.description: When you need Legal's work finished. Not the contract's start or end date.
